name: Peralta / Azkoien (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Peralta (a bridge and a castle on blue above waves, with white mantling).
history: The flag of Peralta is formed of a rectangular cloth of proportion 2/3, red, with the arms of the town in their tinctures at the centre; the arms are azure, a bridge argent surmounted by a castle, whose central gate is round-arched and whose middle window is mullioned.
